0022600227.text: The Philadelphia 76ers (9-3, 2nd in the East and 2nd in the Atlantic, 0.5 games back) host the Toronto Raptors (5-5, 6th in the East and 4th in the Atlantic, 3.5 games back), with both teams coming off a loss and Philadelphia at 7-3 over its last 10 games. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, the 2025-26 series was split 2-2, and the 76ers won the most recent meeting 115-102 in Toronto on January 12, 2026. Out for Philadelphia are Adem Bona (back sprain), Ariel Hukporti (Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back fracture), and out for Toronto are Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation), Nate Bittle (foot fracture) and Scottie Barnes (groin soreness).
